gaps.title: Owned-source search is not modeled as an auditable operation
gaps.description: The system model can resolve supplied context candidates but has no exact search manifest, source-epoch boundary, or operation that proves owned current sources were searched before proposing meaning.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add a source-search request/result contract with searched source identities, epochs, scope, omissions, and a deterministic manifest.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus each source owner

gaps.title: Exact evidence-reference resolution is incomplete
gaps.description: Open gaps are represented, but the model lacks one explicit contract that resolves every declared source, evidence, owner, and relation reference to an exact state or a typed named gap.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add a typed reference-resolution result and fail-closed closure checks for resolved, stale, missing, ambiguous, and conflicting references.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus referenced owners

gaps.title: Language Context View binding is absent
gaps.description: The generic context model has no Language Context View identity, digest, epoch, applied-binding trace, or rejected-binding trace.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add an exact Language Context View input and a binding-application result without universalizing its meanings.
gaps.owner_route: Language owner plus Define runtime owner

gaps.title: Challenge and refresh are not explicit commands
gaps.description: Inspect and resume exist, but no command contract binds a challenge to its responsible owner and refreshes a meaning-bearing result against exact successor inputs.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add challenge and refresh command/event contracts with owner, reason, predecessor, successor, and invalidation semantics.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus affected meaning owners

gaps.title: Successor Definition Pack identity is absent
gaps.description: Session revision is modeled, but material change does not yet create an explicit successor Definition Pack identity with a predecessor link.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add material-change classification and immutable predecessor/successor pack identity rules.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Work Owner

gaps.title: Handled-definition registry custody is absent
gaps.description: Definition Pack state exists, but the system model contains no handled-definition registry or custody behavior that preserves source ownership and blocks promotion.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add the handled-registry output boundary, source-owner preservation, and negative promotion/authority behavior.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Definitions Governance owner

gaps.title: DomainSpec compiler conformance is not established
gaps.description: The model contains an Arcanum substrate seam, but the DomainSpec project remains candidate and current source validation is FLAG because the complete compiler path is not evaluable.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Refresh exact source bindings, obtain admitted compiler/profile execution, and preserve residue plus a non-execution ceiling.
gaps.owner_route: DomainSpec v2 compiler/profile owner plus Define runtime owner

gaps.title: No implemented runtime can emit evidence
gaps.description: The current system ontology declares the runtime not implemented; synthetic fixtures can test evidence shape but cannot satisfy any behavioral obligation.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Implement the smallest session repository and CLI/chat adapters, then run the frozen protocol against exact executable bytes.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus CLI, chat, and next-use owners

gaps.title: Intent traceability lacks a round-trip witness
gaps.description: The model links session scope and Definition Pack, but no witness checks exact Goal, original intent, Context, and owner identities from input through export.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add a digest-bound input-to-pack round-trip witness over identity references rather than copied text.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Work Owner

gaps.title: Related-reference order is inconsistent across models
gaps.description: The obligation includes related references between explicit Context and inferred candidates, while the Product Capability ContextPolicy omits that position and the system design witness includes it.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Reconcile the canonical ordered source ladder or explicitly reject related references before runtime implementation.
gaps.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define runtime owner

gaps.title: Context correction and rejection transitions are absent
gaps.description: Context candidates carry adjacent provenance semantics, but explicit user correction, rejection, and conflict transitions are not modeled.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add correction and rejection commands/events with provenance and preserved conflicting candidates.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Context owner

gaps.title: Sufficiency does not explicitly gate completion
gaps.description: Three-valued evaluation exists, but no explicit rule or edge proves only sufficient Context enables validation or export.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add a completion gate from sufficient evaluation to validate/export and negative paths for insufficient and indeterminate.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus next-use owner

gaps.title: Required-concept denominator is not first class
gaps.description: Definition Pack and exact disposition rules exist, but no manifest binds the complete denominator to Goal, consumer, and intended use.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add a required-concept manifest with immutable identity and exact Goal, consumer, and intended-use bindings.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus next-use owner

gaps.title: Conflict is not a durable first-class record
gaps.description: Queries and open gaps can expose a conflict, but the model lacks a durable record containing both meanings, owner, state, and resolution or acceptance reference.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add a conflict entity and lifecycle that preserves both sides until owner resolution or explicit residue acceptance.
gaps.owner_route: Meaning owner plus Define runtime owner

gaps.title: Disposition-specific payload types are absent
gaps.description: A Definition Pack is validated under an exact-disposition rule, but reuse, specialize, propose, and open payloads are not first-class types with distinct required fields.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add closed disposition payload schemas and negative fixtures for each missing field.
gaps.owner_route: Definitions Governance owner plus Define runtime owner

gaps.title: Sufficiency is not bound to the named consumer use
gaps.description: Consumer/use and Context sufficiency appear separately, but no exact relation binds one evaluation to that consumer's intended use.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Bind every sufficiency evaluation to exact consumer and intended-use identities.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus next-use owner

gaps.title: Stop conditions are distributed, not complete
gaps.description: Several enforcing rules and rejection events exist, but no complete matrix covers every named stop cause and proves no output or effect follows it.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add a stop-condition matrix with one negative witness per cause and explicit no-output/no-effect assertions.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus affected decision owners

gaps.title: Proportional human interruption lacks paired evidence
gaps.description: The policy exists, but evidence does not classify consequential interruption points or prove mechanical work proceeds without unnecessary interruption.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add paired required-interruption and uninterrupted-mechanical-path fixtures.
gaps.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define runtime owner

gaps.title: Durable questions lack complete business fields
gaps.description: Question state is modeled, but each durable question or non-answer does not yet require reason, owner, blocked use, next action, refresh route, and handoff reference.
gaps.required_artifact_or_behavior: Add the missing fields and preserve them in both interface directions across restart.
gaps.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus each question owner

claim_ceiling: These are candidate evidence and model gaps. Recording a gap does not select a design, appoint an owner, authorize implementation, or establish nonconformance.
